QUOTE: "the pattern is split at the first `:`. The left side is fnmatched against the tool name. With no `:`, that is the whole test (tool-level). With a `:`, the full pattern is fnmatched against `tool_name:<arg-pattern>`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states fnmatch, splitting at the first colon into tool and argument parts, and that a pattern with no colon matches on the tool name alone.
